verdict.rationale: Custom metadata and property templates are a fair axis for a file-storage developer platform, so the story applies. However, the evidence pack never documents property templates or setting and querying custom metadata via the API. The Files API evidence covers only basic file operations (create, read, edit, move, delete), and the search mentions do not cover metadata-based queries.

support.subject: As a developer, files carry my schema — custom metadata/properties templates that can be set and queried via the API
